Morgan and Casey,
Great meeting you at the conference, and thanks for coming by the booth again, Morgan. You mentioned you want your team to take a look, so here's the quick version.
The emails that hurt districts now are the plain-text ones, like a vendor changing bank details or a payroll change from a spoofed staff member. There's no link or attachment, so Gmail filtering lets them through.
Abnormal connects to Google Workspace by API with no MX change, and it pulls those emails before staff act. Your team can see it run read-only against your own mail before you decide anything. Florida schools can also buy it through a cooperative contract, and I can confirm whether Lakeside qualifies.
